ICS:
The fellow sets up the interview

Expectations: maintains privacy, involve appropriate family/friends, introduces self, sits down, make a connection, manage time and interruptions

The fellow assesses the family’s understanding and perception of the situation

Expectations: asks for the family to explain the situation in their own words, clarify as needed

The fellow obtains the family’s invitation for a discussion

Expectations: transitions the conversation, explains reason for the meeting

The fellow appropriately delivers the news and information to the family

Expectations: appropriate vocabulary, avoid medical jargon, clear and concise, check family’s understanding

The fellow addresses the family’s emotions and shows empathy

Expectations: uses exploratory questions as needed, validates feelings

The fellow summarizes the discussion and shares the plan of action with the family

Expectations: clear and concise, gives timeline for future steps and follow-up
